# OmniComms AI

> Your AI Employees. Your voice is the new interface.

OmniComms AI is an autonomous, multi-modal conversational AI platform built for regulated professionals — loan officers, mortgage brokers, realtors, insurance agents, and financial advisors — whose income depends on relationships and whose license depends on documentation.

## What It Does

OmniComms AI acts as your AI Employee. You give it voice instructions — while driving, between meetings — and it executes: calls, texts, emails, follow-ups, scheduling, and document delivery across every communication channel with full context and a complete audit trail.

- Voice-first interface: give instructions by speaking naturally
- Omnichannel: phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Telegram, YouTube, Reddit
- Persistent memory: every conversation, every channel, every client — for years
- Human-in-the-loop: mission-critical actions require real-time approval via push notification
- Full audit trail: every interaction logged immutably for compliance

## Security

- Zero Trust Master Key Architecture (Enterprise tier, planned)
- End-to-end encryption and immutable audit logging from day one
- Data encrypted at rest using keys only the customer controls (OpenBao vault infrastructure)
- Server cannot decrypt or access customer data without their master key

## Who Built This

Founded by Lavon Woods — a licensed mortgage broker and 25+-year software engineer who left his engineering career in 2019 to help his father's mortgage business. OmniComms AI was born from firsthand experience in a regulated, relationship-driven industry where high-touch doesn't scale.

## Patent

Patent pending: "System and Method for Autonomous Multi-Modal Conversational AI Agent Operation Enabling Multi-Day Workflows Without Persistent Connections" — Filed November 16, 2025.

Currently in development. Founding beta opening soon. Accepting early access requests for 50 founding members at 50% off for life.
